recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce the Condition outcome extension StructureDefinition to core; future changes to that extension should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack, while core should continue to own the active condition-outcome value set used by FamilyMemberHistory and the extension binding.
issue_request: FHIR-7858 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. It asked how to represent patient cause of death and resolved to add Condition.outcome as an extension, use a condition outcome value set, and add a usage note that patient cause of death is typically captured as Observation, that outcome does not imply causality, and that outcomes might not be assessable until Condition.clinicalStatus is no longer active.
initial_application: Git commit e5933ab3cb970792db0fa1415abff23b2e0ea799 applied #7858 in 2015 by adding source/condition/valueset-condition-outcome.xml and changing the then-current Condition extension spreadsheet. The extension later existed in core as source/condition/structuredefinition-extension-condition-outcome.xml before R5 extension-source cleanup.
additional_context: The current core build configuration actively includes Condition, Patient, FamilyMemberHistory, and source/condition/valueset-condition-outcome.xml. Current core no longer owns the Condition outcome extension StructureDefinition because dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed resource-specific extensions from R5 core source. The current FHIR Extension Pack defines StructureDefinition/condition-outcome for Condition and includes the expected Observation/causality/clinicalStatus usage note and binding to the core value set. Related final decisions keep cause of death off Patient and distinguish FamilyMemberHistory outcome from causality.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The only needed reconciliation is an audit record because the authoritative current sources are already correct: core supplies the shared condition-outcome value set and the Extension Pack supplies the extension definition and note.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - No Change issue rejecting a core Patient reason-for-death element and noting that cause-of-death modeling was unclear and likely belongs in extensions or Observation.
Published FamilyMemberHistory change adding condition.contributedToDeath and clarifying that condition.outcome records what happened following the condition and does not imply causality.
Published FamilyMemberHistory Procedure change that reused parallel outcome/contributedToDeath semantics and the condition-outcome value set family.
Mentioned in a FHIR-7858 comment, but it concerns Encounter diagnosis/reason modeling rather than Condition outcome or Patient cause-of-death representation.
